recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. No related issue needs a separate reconcile decision because the related Jira-tagged changes were only history explaining drift on the same page.
issue_request: FHIR-38860 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core-http and requested consistent <code> formatting for HTTP status codes, reason phrases inside the same code span when present, first-use reason phrases, and RFC 9110 status text/capitalization.
initial_application: The Jira comments identify HL7/fhir#2425 and merge commit 7e91cbf62229789daece22e45563bbe92563fc0a as the original application. That PR and included commit ee761ef4bd5a52057846f25556c859510db5375c reformatted many source/http.html status-code references, but current source still had 422 wording that did not match RFC 9110 and later edits introduced additional formatting slips.
additional_context: FHIR-I WGM minutes on 2023-01-19 record FHIR-38860 as Persuasive with an 11-0-5 vote. Later source history on source/http.html, including FHIR-39137 search-method wording and FHIR-42728 conditional-delete wording, explained some of the current inconsistencies. RFC 9110 section 15.5.21 defines status 422 as Unprocessable Content.
reconciliation: Updated source/http.html to use 422 Unprocessable Content, correct 404 NotFound to 404 Not Found, keep 405 and 501 reason phrases inside the same <code> span, and add the RFC 9110 reason phrase to the first explicit 500 reference.
source_changes: source/http.html: changed five 422 reason-phrase references from Unprocessable Entity to Unprocessable Content.
source/http.html: corrected the conditional-delete example from 404 NotFound to 404 Not Found.
source/http.html: normalized 405 and 501 references so the reason phrase is inside the same <code> span as the numeric status code.
source/http.html: changed the first explicit 500 status reference to 500 Internal Server Error.

related_jiras.note: A later search-method edit on source/http.html introduced a 405 status-code phrase that needed the same formatting rule.
A later conditional-delete edit on source/http.html introduced the 404 NotFound typo corrected by this reconciliation.
